violations.text: A block of butter was observed on the floor with rodent gnaw marks. Person in charge voluntarily disposed of food at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

Pico was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit in a deli container stored in the hotel pan of the flip top prep unit. Foods are to be kept directly inside hotel pans if kept in flip top prep unit to promote proper cold holding temperature. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, food kept in unit under an hour prior to inspection. Food moved to hotel pan into refrigeration to properly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026
